description.fun: Scraggy headbutts anyone who makes eye contact with it, proud of its massively thick skull, though the weight makes it a bit wobbly. It pulls its saggy, rubbery skin up to its neck like trousers for protection, and among Scraggy, the saggier the skin, the more respect it gets. It's thought to evolve once that skin has stretched out completely. Its look may play on hip-hop and punk styles.
description.guide: Scraggy is a Dark- and Fighting-type lizard Pokémon with a very hard skull and loose skin it can pull up for protection. It headbutts anyone who makes eye contact with it. It evolves into Scrafty.
description.tagline: A saggy-trousered punk lizard that headbutts on sight.

description.fun: Scrafty lives in gangs that beat up anything entering their turf, led by the one with the biggest crest, and the bigger the crest, the more arrogant its owner. It spits to taunt foes, and its half-hearted-looking kicks can shatter Conkeldurr's concrete pillars. Rude as it is, it takes very good care of its family, friends and territory, which it's said never to leave its whole life. Its mohawk and hoodie play on punk and hip-hop styles.
description.guide: Scrafty is the evolved form of Scraggy, a Dark- and Fighting-type lizard Pokémon that lives in groups led by the one with the biggest crest. It protects itself with its shed skin while kicking. It can Mega Evolve into Mega Scrafty, introduced in Pokémon Legends: Z-A.
description.tagline: A hoodie-wearing gang leader who's soft on family.

description.fun: Mega Evolution turns its shed skin pure white, tough and supple, and Scrafty wears it like a hoodie and a pair of ripped trousers, cracking its neck with a slouching swagger. It's still as feisty as ever.
